description: This file defines a migration class for version 4.7 of the OrangeHRM system, extending an abstract migration class and providing version information without any database changes.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A class representing a database migration for OrangeHRM version 4.7, extending the AbstractMigration class and implementing methods to retrieve the migration version and perform migration steps (none in this case).

methods.name: up
methods.description: Defines the actions to perform during the migration process. In this case, no database changes are required.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string '4.7' indicating the migration version.
